 "rationale": "Core: Q1(1x)/Q2(8x) with matched subthreshold NMOS pair forces equal emitters, so I = UT·ln8/R1 = 0.4 uA. A 2x PMOS mirror gives 0.8 uA into Ra+Q3||Rb, so Vref = Rb/(Ra+Rb)·(Veb3 + Io·Ra). That is about 0.8 × 1.2 V ≈ 0.95 V with the TC near zero. Supply current is about 1.65 uA, roughly 3 uW. Wide, L=2 PMOS keep Vsg ≈ 0.8 V for headroom at 1.6 V. A vref-sensing start-up pulls the PMOS gate low only when vref is low."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wp":  (240.0, 80.0, 600.0),     # PMOS mirror unit width [um] (deep subthreshold -> low Vsg)
    "Lp":  (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),          # PMOS L [um] (high ro for PSRR/line reg)
    "Wn":  (20.0, 5.0, 60.0),        # NMOS level-shift pair width [um]
    "Ln":  (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),          # NMOS L [um]
    "R1":  (134.6e3, 90e3, 200e3),   # PTAT resistor -> I = UT ln8 / R1
    "Ra":  (650e3, 450e3, 900e3),    # series PTAT resistor in output branch
    "Rb":  (2.6e6, 1.8e6, 3.6e6),    # shunt divider resistor (scales Vref to ~0.95 V)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]
    R1, Ra, Rb = p["R1"], p["Ra"], p["Rb"]

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # ---- PTAT core ----
    # branch 1: M3 (pmos mirror out) -> ng (M1 diode) -> e1 (Q1 x1)
    n.M("M3", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M1", "ng", "ng", "e1", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    # branch 2: M4 (pmos diode) -> pg ; M2 -> s2 -> R1 -> e2 (Q2 xN)
    n.M("M4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "ng", "s2", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # ---- output: 2x mirror into (Ra + Q3) || Rb  -> scaled bandgap ----
    n.M("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wp, Lp)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "e3", Ra)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    # ---- start-up: x high while vref low -> MS1 pulls pg low ----
    n.M("MSP", "x", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 10.0)   # weak pull-up, ~off when vref~0.95
    n.M("MSN", "x", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)       # strong pull-down once core runs
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 1.0)      # kick device

    # ---- predictions ----
    def veb(I, m=1, T=27.0):
        Tk = T + 273.15
        ut = 1.380649e-23 * Tk / 1.602176634e-19
        v27 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I / (10e-6 * m))
        # Veb(T) ~ Vg0 - (Vg0 - Veb27)*T/T0 - (eta)UT ln(T/T0)
        return 1.17 - (1.17 - v27) * Tk / 300.15 - 3.0 * ut * math.log(Tk / 300.15)

    def vref_at(T):
        Tk = T + 273.15
        ut = 1.380649e-23 * Tk / 1.602176634e-19
        I = ut * math.log(N) / R1
        Io = 2 * I
        v = 0.95
        for _ in range(30):
            iq = max(Io - v / Rb, 1e-9)
            v = (veb(iq, 1, T) + Io * Ra) * Rb / (Ra + Rb)
        return v, I

    v27, I0 = vref_at(27.0)
    vs = [vref_at(t)[0] for t in (-40.0, 0.0, 27.0, 60.0, 90.0, 125.0)]
    tc = (max(vs) - min(vs)) / (v27 * 165.0) * 1e6

    # PMOS operating point (headroom / ro) via forward LUT
    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            try:
                i = lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]
            except Exception:
                i = 0.0
            if i < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    gds5 = 2 * I0 / 200.0
    vsg = 0.85
    try:
        vsg = solve_vgs("p", Wp, Lp, I0, 0.8)
        op5 = lut.op("p", 2 * Wp, Lp, vsg, 1.8 - v27)
        gds5 = op5["gds"]
    except Exception:
        pass
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rb + 1.0 / (Ra + UT / max(2 * I0 - v27 / Rb, 1e-8)))
    gain_sup = gds5 * rout * 1.5 + 1e-4     # x1.5 for core-current supply sensitivity
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(gain_sup)
    line_reg = gain_sup

    itot = 2 * I0 + 2 * I0 + 0.05e-6
    power = 1.8 * itot

    return n, {"vref": v27, "tc_ppm": tc, "psrr_1k": psrr, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "startup_ok": 1, "vsg_p": vsg,
               "m2_vds_at_1v6": 1.6 - vsg - veb(I0)}
